risk_note: RV2 by path (admin module). Closes the B1-34h round-2 S2 window: enabling an account now writes the account's voiding instant at its Clock instant inside the locked transaction before commit (a Redis failure rolls the enable back), and binding an authenticator (first binding, including the rebind after a reset) writes one at the bind ticket's opening instant floored to the whole second, so the step's own check and the admin_token it issues (whole-second iat) stay valid. A session that survived a disable or a reset racing the final login step across a second boundary therefore cannot revive after enable or rebind. Renaming and saving permission points still revoke nothing (contract). No contract, schema or migration. Rule tests by an independent Claude (approvals #36), red before the implementation; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run.
